draft.shortGloss: to fix; to correct; to cure
notes: Transitive compound verb (takes ने in perfective tenses). Its intransitive counterpart is ठीक होना ('to get fixed, to recover').
For improving skills or habits, सुधारना is preferred over ठीक करना.
